note: Cross-dataset armor on a 2nd steel SEM set (bainite, 3 documented-subjective subclasses). GroupKFold by specimen (leakage-safe, lesson from UHCSDB). NOT the inter-observer ballgame: single consensus label per image, no per-annotator labels released. Ambiguity test is proxy (VTL-space margin vs VTL/own errors), not observer-independent.
ambiguity_caveat: CIRCULAR: VTL-space margin predicting VTL classifier own-errors is partly tautological (both in same space). Not a fuzziness validation. The non-circular test (margin vs an INDEPENDENT descriptor errors, as UHCSDB C.2 did vs HOG/Haralick) was not run on bainite (no independent features computed).
power_caveat: Only 26 specimens (i=13, ii=7, iii=6); grouped macro AUC 0.964 has a wide CI. Classes are an M-A island SIZE ordering (small/mixed/large), which VTL blob/island coords capture directly.
full_set_examined: Pulled the full set (im_train_aug_768, 932 tiles). It is AUGMENTED (UUID-suffixed original_..._<hash> and 768_ variants), not new specimens — true physical specimens number far fewer and cannot be cleanly degrouped from augmentation naming. Combining would manufacture bigger-N via augmentation leakage. Decision: do NOT combine; the authors held-out test set (386 tiles, 26 genuine specimens) remains the clean evaluation. arm15 (0.964, 26-specimen caveat) stands.
